changes.evidence: Iron Fist S1 episode 7: the board (Lawrence Wilkins) votes Ward and Joy out of Rand Enterprises and offers severance. After Wilkins's death the Meachums are let back in, and by episode 12-13 Ward is running the company again (he proposes running it with Danny). No stage records the vote-out or the return.

Iron Fist S1 episode 7: the board votes the Meachums out of Rand Enterprises. Episode 10: Joy is let back in on Maria Rodriguez's proposal. Episode 13: after Harold's death she leaves the company and New York (Ward: he won't run the company alone 'now that Joy had left') and meets Davos in Paris. So she is already out by the end of S1, not first in S2.

Frank's Marine Corps service and his Cerberus Squad tour (Kandahar) both end before his first title. He comes home for good on April 3, 2015, before the Central Park massacre that sets up Daredevil S2. In The Punisher S1 Cerberus appears only in flashbacks. He isn't in either group during any title he's on file for.
In The Punisher S1 (episode 5) Gunner is already a former Marine hiding alone in the woods after leaking the Kandahar footage. His USMC and Cerberus service happens only in backstory and flashbacks.

Curtis lost his leg and left the Navy before The Punisher S1. In S1 and S2 he is a civilian who runs the New York Veteran Support Group (the wiki lists USN as 'formerly'). Note: the owner may prefer [["New York Veteran Support Group","(from the start)"]] if that group is tracked.

Micro's NSA career ends before The Punisher S1, when Carson Wolf shoots him and he is presumed dead (shown in flashback in episode 3, 'Kandahar'). Throughout S1 he is in hiding, working with Frank, not with the NSA.

owner_calls.question: Saunders secretly defects from the AVTF in Daredevil: Born Again S2. What should his S2 stage be?
options: Keep ['NYPD','Daredevil: Born Again S2'] as is
['Matt's resistance','Daredevil: Born Again S2'] (defects to help Daredevil)
['Anti-Vigilante Task Force',...] only, with no S2 stage (he stays in the Task Force while secretly helping)
owner_calls.evidence: S2 episodes 2-3: Saunders goes looking for Daredevil and Karen and gives them his Red Hook keycard. The Daredevil's Army page says he was 'defecting from the AVTF'. He keeps serving on the Task Force, and in episode 6 Powell kills him 'for betraying the AVTF'. The wiki doesn't list him as a resistance member, and nothing shows him leaving the AVTF for regular NYPD duty.

owner_calls.question: Should Soledad get a stage in Matt's resistance from Daredevil: Born Again S2?
options: [['Independent','Daredevil: Born Again S1'],['Matt's resistance','Daredevil: Born Again S2']]
owner_calls.evidence: The Daredevil's Army page lists Soledad Ayala as a former member, and her page lists Daredevil's Army as an affiliation. In S2 episode 3 Daredevil frees her from Red Hook; in episode 4 she records testimony against the AVTF at Ariana Iacovou's safehouse. Being freed is not a move under the owner's rules. Giving testimony may or may not count as joining.

owner_calls.question: Daredevil's Army is marked 'Defunct' after Fisk resigns in Daredevil: Born Again S2 episode 8. Should its members get a departure there? This also applies to A:st-cherry, A:st-bb-urich and A:st-angela-del-toro.
options: Keep as is (no disbanding is shown on screen)
Add ['Independent','Daredevil: Born Again S2'] or their other group after the resistance stage
owner_calls.evidence: The wiki lists every member as 'formerly' and the group's status as Defunct once Fisk resigns at the end of S2. No scene shows the group disbanding.
